name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 28, 2015
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Sheri Rowe, Sheri Rowe Ministries
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring May 9, 2015, to be "Adam Gregory Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation by Coleen Clementson, San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) Principal Regional Planner, providing an overview of San Diego Forward: The Regional Plan.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Dissolution of the San Diego Pooled Insurance Program Authority (SANDPIPA) (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving the dissolution of SANDPIPA and the distribution of its assets; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , authorizing the City of Vista to join CSAC Excess Insurance Authority.
C4.
CIP No. 8125 - Contract for Owner's Representative Services (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Downtown Specific Plan Update (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
D2.
Treasurer’s Cash Report for Month Ending February 28, 2015 (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Inclusionary Housing Requirements for Multi-Family Residential Projects and Second Units (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider proposed amendments to chapters 18.31, 18.34, and 18.35 of the Development Code related to inclusionary housing requirements for multi-family residential projects and second units, and deleting City Council Policy 300-13 related to inclusionary housing.
2.
Introduce and adopt the following:
a.
City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Vista Development Code Chapters 18.34, R-M Multi-Residential Zone, and 18.35, M-U Mixed Use Zone, to Repeal Inclusionary Housing Requirements"; and
b.
City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Vista Development Code Chapter 18.31, Second Unit Requirements, to Repeal Affordable Housing Covenants for Second Units."
(Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , repealing City Council Policy 300-13, Inclusionary Housing.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
